versions.content: When responding to UDS Service 0x19 with subfunc- tion 0x05 and DTCStoredDataRecordNumber is 0x00, the Dcm shall call Dem_DcmGetDTCOfOBDFreezeFrame() with FrameNumber 0x00 and DTCFormat DEM_DTC_FORMAT_UDS to retrieve the DTC of the provided FreezeFrame.
